newsitem.title: CHINA: EU and China agree on technology working group.
newsitem.headline: EU and China agree on technology working group.

text.p: The European Union and China on Wednesday signed a joint declaration that creates a working group of officials and businessmen to discuss information and telecommunication technologies, EU officials said.

The working group would deal with issues such as standardisation and telecommunications regulation, said Martin Bangemann, EU commissioner for industrial affairs and information and telecommunications technologies.

It would also deal with suppport and technical assistance for the study of telematics projects for China, promote joint ventures and a dialogue between the Chinese and European industry and boost scientific cooperation, Bangemann said.
Access to China's closely-guarded telecommunications market is one of a number of issues the European Union says is blocking Beijing's long-delayed entry to the World Trade Organisation.
Bangemann said Chinese leaders and officials had expressed willingness to open up their markets but that they had made no detailed commitments.
